title: Emeka Egbuka, Jalen McMillan return to practice on Monday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Emeka Egbuka, Jalen McMillan return to practice on Monday
sources.description: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles told reporters last week that receivers Emeka Egbuka and Jalen McMillan were “headed in the right direction” as they deal with their respective injuries.
